integrity: All analytic identities are explicit. Sample computations are diagnostic and not presented as proof of the infinite-dimensional-index family. No independent review has been performed.
limitations: The exact two-orbit count holds only within the 3-periodic (A,B,0) support family. No complete unrestricted fiber, all-window, or stability theorem is claimed. Prior-history search and specialist bibliographic searches cannot establish absolute priority.
title: A connected separated counterexample to three-tap cyclic STFT phase retrieval
